UNITED STATES ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY WASHINGTON, D.C. 20460
MAY 4 1972
Mr. Thomas J. Madden
Acting Assistant Administrator
Office of the General Counsel
U.S. Department of Justice
Law Enforcement Assistance Administration
Washington, D.C. 20530
Dear Mr. Madden:
We have reviewed the U.S. Department of Justice's draft environmental impact statement for the eradication of marijuana in Pulaski County, Indiana. We recognize the urgency of the situation and we realize that treatment with a herbicide may be the best answer for the control of this weed infestation. The 2,4-D herbicide proposed for use is registered for the control of wild hemp and can be used on ditch banks as well as other infested acreage. The use of a commercial concern for application of this material insures that proper precautions will be followed.
We feel that the proposed eradication program will have no serious impact on the environment.
We thank you for the opportunity to review this draft statement and ask that you send us five copies of the final statement.
Sincerely yours,
Sheldon Meyers, Director Office of Federal Activities
Sheldon Mergere
